# LandscapeCriticalPointRetention

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The degree to which random projections preserve the number and type of critical points (minima, maxima, saddles) of a high-dimensional objective function. Critical for neuromorphic learning algorithms that rely on gradient-free or landscape-guided search in compressed feature spaces.
